task: first playable sealed-stone bridge through existing NPC dialog links

presentation: Decorate enabled approved NPC dialogs with one workshop entry while preserving original content/menu/exit links.
Home explains actual Bag source conversion and fixed generation-time result, and offers eligible ores/raw stones.
Item lists have at most three physical item choices per server page, stable exact decimal selectors and previous/next/back links.
Ore detail explains single physical source conversion, fixed matching grade and zero sealing gold fee.
Raw-stone detail shows six real material possibilities, exact basis-point percentages, frozen appraisal/cut fees and only an earned coarse clue.

bridge.nextExplicitPhase: Dedicated materials/sidebar UI integration remains next; this bridge uses existing NPC flow only.

api.fields: packets:Vec<ServerPacket>,replayed:bool,public_result:String. public_result should be localized or blank and describe only committed Cut result.
(world:&World,object_id:u32)->bool; actual Npc+NpcAgent exact script/map/position proof. Root workshop_allowed can reuse this.
(world:&World,dialog:&mut ActiveNpcDialogState). Uses workshop_enabled(world), approved_npc; no view getter needed.
(session:&mut SimulationSession,target:&str)->Option<Vec<ServerPacket>>. Must hook after original live-link/DataRange checks and pass original target unchanged, not normalized_target.

targetProtocol.selectors: Canonical decimal u64 strings; exact overflow/leading-zero/empty/sign rejection. Physical UID and private-registry serial remain distinct opaque selectors.
targetProtocol.requestId: stone- followed by 64 lowercase SHA256 hex characters. Hash domain includes owner account/incarnation with length prefixes, operation, UID-or-serial, item revision and inventory revision.
targetProtocol.authority: Hash is deterministic request identity, not a secret or possession permission. Handler also requires exact target in current displayed link set, approved live actual NPC, Root workshop_allowed and current view revisions. Core authority still checks actual holder and atomic persistence.
targetProtocol.navigation: Old navigation links can refresh the current public preview. Old action links can fail closed; original core receipt replay remains supported by Root.
targetProtocol.strictness: Exact version/token count, bounds and decimal parser reject extra fields, parenthesized arguments, whitespace, uppercase variants, unknown versions/operations and arbitrary QA/debug commands.

failureBehavior.localRefusal: Localized notice with source/item preserved by core; refresh public view and remain on source detail when it exists.
failureBehavior.unknownCommit: OutcomeUnknown produces localized reconnect/check-Bag notice, removes every stone navigation/action link, keeps original merchant menu/exit and does not call execution or view refresh again.
failureBehavior.hiddenData: UI reads only PublicStone; hidden outcomes/source/roll/seed/registry records are not accepted by this helper or rendered. Seal/Appraise never forward public_result.

Existing NPC native dialog paging reads all rows and has scroll up/down when more than nine rows; six-material detail can use current rendering.
